scripts.dev: bun "$(ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); if [ -f "$ROOT/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts" ]; then echo "$ROOT/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts"; else echo "$ROOT/oss/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts"; fi)" watch-bun ./src/server.ts
scripts.db:push:test: sh -c 'set -a; . ./.env.test; set +a; bunx prisma db push --accept-data-loss --schema ../../db/prisma/schema --config ../../db/prisma.config.ts && bunx prisma db push --accept-data-loss --schema ../../multi-region/prisma/schema --config ../../multi-region/prisma.config.ts'
scripts.test:e2e: bun -e "let response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + (process.env.API_PORT || '4310')); if (response.status >= 500) throw new Error('app-api returned HTTP ' + response.status); console.log('app-api responded with HTTP ' + response.status)"
